narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Like squares, cube numbers have an odd number of factors.
<bookmark mark='eight'/>Eight is two cubed, and its factors are one, two, four and eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is four factors, an even count, so the last claim is false.
